name: lean-prompt
description: Shrink the resident prompt: heavy tool schemas move to specialist sub-agents, low-frequency session-state features are cut, knowledge moves to on-demand skills. Ships a balanced profile (default) and a minimal router profile.

interface.shortDescription: Progressive disclosure for tools and knowledge
interface.longDescription: Removes MCP tool schemas, media reading and low-frequency session-state tools (Cron*/Goal*/WaitFor) from the main agent's resident prompt, routing that work to specialist sub-agents; ships a minimal router profile for delegation-only sessions and a prompt-audit skill that measures what actually occupies your context.
